objectives.primary: Maximize throughput and frequent control decisions to prevent starvation and enable early gap-out
secondary: Minimize waiting time for all vehicles, with modest extra weight for bus and emergency
Reward vehicles that clear the intersection (throughput-first flow)
Balance wait across N, S, E, W without overpowering delay
Avoid queue spillback without freezing the signal (proportional penalties)
enforced_outside_rl: Action masking — agent cannot select illegal phase switches
Phase ring: N_ALL → S_ALL → E_ALL → W_ALL (thru + left per arm, not dual-left splits)
Dynamic min green: max(safety_min, min(min_green_cap, cars*sec_per_car)) — cap is a floor, not fixed phase length
Agent may hold green longer than min green cap unless max_green is set
Baseline compare: fixed seconds per phase; DQN compare reloads identical snapshot traffic
Bulk-first actuated switching when switching is allowed
Bus/emergency: next green when switching (min green respected); no instant phase cut
